name: @mushinjs/plugin-browser
description: Lets Fairy use a browser on this machine (Chrome, Edge or Chromium): open pages, read them, click and type, with the page shown in the Fairy workspace

description.en: Lets Fairy use Chrome, Edge or Chromium on this machine: open pages, read them, click, type and take screenshots, shown live in the Fairy workspace
description.zh-CN: 让 Fairy 使用本机的 Chrome、Edge 或 Chromium：打开网页、读取内容、点击、输入和截图，并在 Fairy 工作区里实时显示
